product: Pega Platform and Pega Infinity 26, including Pega Blueprint AI design agents, Pega Infinity Studio and Pega Customer Decision Hub. They automate deterministic, governed enterprise workflows such as loan approval, claims underwriting and customer service for regulated industries (2026-06-08 press release; 2026-06-08 investor session).
demand: Volume and mix, not disclosed price. Q2 2026 (2026-07-21 8-K) Pega Cloud revenue up 28% y/y and subscription services up 17%, consulting down 13%, subscription license flat. ACV growth of 7% came from cloud workloads and new logos; a new per-case pricing model starts Q3 2026 (2026-06-08).
pricing_power: Q2 2026 cost of subscription services jumped 30% y/y to $53.9M on cloud and AI compute mix, and H1 GAAP net income fell 60% to $46.1M (2026-07-21 8-K). H1 legal fees reached $37.9M on Appian litigation. Prolonged ACV slowdown could force discounting or heavier token and compute costs.
competition: Cheaper substitutes exist: Microsoft Power Platform, ServiceNow, Appian, UiPath, Camunda and open-source BPM, plus Chinese low-code vendors. None is close for governed mission-critical decisioning at scale; CFO said 2026-09-08 clients are pitched by many AI-native and service-provider alternatives. Chinese tools address simpler workflows only.
market_strategy: CEO Alan Trefler promised on 2026-06-08 that clients can design, build and run agentic workflows on Pega Infinity 26 without paying per token, available Q3 2026 at a flat price per completed case. On 2026-07-21 he said Pega applies agents at design time for predictable costs and outcomes.
bull: Pega Cloud ACV +22% y/y and cloud revenue +28% y/y (2026-07-21 8-K); pipeline +29% and new-logo pipeline +126% (2026-06-08); per-case pricing ships Q3 2026, cutting client token costs.
bear: CFO said 2026-09-08 FY2026 ACV growth will be near 10%, not 15%; six target cuts in 90 days; Q2 GAAP net income -56%, subscription cost +30%, H1 legal fees $37.9M.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results showing FY2026 ACV growth below the ~10% the CFO indicated on 2026-09-08, or Pega Cloud ACV growth under 20% versus 22% at 2026-07-21.
